corrected.derivation: Figure 2.20 caption (page 49): 'PMMA (NASA and Astra) in 1g at San Diego State University'. Sec. 2.3.5 is titled 'Microgravity and Normal-Gravity Experiments' (page 45); page 48 calls these 'the normal-gravity experiments'; page 23 calls them 'ground data from the San Diego State University (SDSU) flame stabilizer'. Condition stated once for the series; per-thickness values exist only in plots and are not invented. Stated discrepancy, not averaged: Fig. 2.20 caption (page 49) gives 20.7 percent O2 and 79 percent N2 at 1 atm; text on page 46 gives 101 kPa and 21 percent O2. Other 1-g data in the report (Fig. 2.15 forced-flow tunnel Ref. 18; Fernandez-Pello and Williams and Ref. 23 data in Fig. 2.22; SDSU Flame Tunnel; Ch. 4 rods) are NOT part of this series.

Against this: the B3 log has single values and no recorded reduction; B16 (7/2/2014, 17.3 % O2) also starts at 3 but is not 'the same conditions'. Range: about 1.1 (extinction) to 3 (set).

Flow configuration per series: B opposed (page 29), M opposed (page 64), T SIBAL concurrent (page 102), T3/T7 stagnation, F1-F3 concurrent, F4 disputed (text opposed vs table stagnation), P16/P19 concurrent.
Flow ranges per PI (Olson 0-55 cm/s, Miller 3-20 cm/s, T'ien 1-53 cm/s); hardware maximum ~55 cm/s (page 12).
O2 varied from ~21% down to ~14% (page 14); 13.6 to 22.2% for the O series (page 72).
Lineage: the flow duct was built for gas-jet flame studies (SPICE) and adapted for BASS (page 12); BASS and BASS-II tests are pooled in T'ien's section with colliding test ids.
126 BASS-II tests per page 11 vs 129 PSI rows: O20-O22 (2016) are not confirmed as BASS-II.
The report contains 1-g ground and 5.18-s drop-tower data with no PSI test ids.

Other 1-g data in the Summary Report that are NOT this series and were not extracted: Fig. 2.15 vertical combustion tunnel (Ref. 18), Fernandez-Pello and Williams literature data and the Ref. 23 sample (Fig. 2.22), the SDSU vertical Flame Tunnel (page 23), 1-g PMMA rods of Chapter 4 (pages 57-58).
